codesFaq.question: How do I redeem codes?
codesFaq.answer: Open the game, click the settings gear in the top-right, paste your code into the Redeem Code field, and confirm. Codes are case-sensitive.

codesFaq.question: Why do codes stop working?
codesFaq.answer: Codes expire on a schedule set by the developer (usually monthly or tied to update milestones), and some are one-per-account. This page is re-tested regularly.

codesFaq.question: How often are new codes released?
codesFaq.answer: New codes typically arrive with each major game update. Bookmark this page and check back after every patch.

codesFaq.question: Do codes expire?
codesFaq.answer: Yes — most codes have an expiry date, shown next to each code. Expired codes move to the expired table below.

dealsPage.metaDescription: Compare free game deals with Steam prices, live player activity, rankings, and current retailer offers.
dealsPage.posterTagline: Compare current game offers with Steam prices, live player counts, and current retailer deals.
dealsPage.title: Game deals
dealsPage.intro: Compare verified retailer prices with the current Steam listing. Steam player activity and available offers are checked independently, so missing data is never presented as a confirmed discount.
dealsPage.regionNote: Prices are shown in USD. Retailer availability and checkout terms may change by region.
dealsPage.steamHelper: Player count is a current snapshot from Steam's public API.
dealsPage.retailerHelper: Only same-edition offers priced below Steam are counted in the comparison.
dealsPage.comparisonUnavailable: Steam’s current price could not be read, so retailer prices cannot be safely compared yet.
dealsPage.noDeals: Currently no deals found. Steam and retailer data were checked; see the refresh time above and check back later.
dealsPage.noDealsPartial: No discount below Steam was returned by the available retailer source. Another price source is temporarily unavailable, so this result may be incomplete.
dealsPage.offerSourcesUnavailable: Retailer price sources are temporarily unavailable. This is a data-source error, so the page is not treating it as “no offers found.”
dealsPage.popularHelper: Current coupons and discounts for games ranked in Steam's live top-20 most-played chart. Ranks are refreshed from Steam; offer timestamps come from the source snapshot.
dealsPage.popularitySourceUnavailable: The popular-games offer source is temporarily unavailable.
dealsPage.noPopularOffers: No current coupon or discounted listing was found for Steam's live top-20 games. The source snapshot time is shown above.
dealsPage.snapshotPrefix: Offers and player counts in the source snapshot:
dealsPage.snapshotStale: This offer snapshot is older. Check the linked retailer page to confirm its current price and availability.
dealsPage.dataError: Current offer data could not be reached. This is a data-source error, so the page is not treating it as “no offers found.”
dealsPage.refreshError: A live data refresh failed. The last update time is shown when cached data is available; try Refresh now in a moment.
dealsPage.hourlyRefresh: The page refreshes automatically every hour.
dealsPage.steamSummaryNoPrice: Steam’s current price could not be read, so retailer prices cannot be safely compared yet.
dealsPage.noLowerPrice: Currently no deals found below the Steam price. The page checked live retailer and Steam listings; the latest refresh time is shown above.
dealsPage.footerRetailers: Offer prices and coupon eligibility are set by each retailer. Confirm the final price and regional availability on the linked store page before purchase.
dealsPage.footerActivity: The Steam player count is a point-in-time activity measure, not a review score or all-time record. Steam's current popularity position is shown only when the live ranking source provides it.
